verdict.rationale: Zep documents an official Python SDK installed with `pip install zep-cloud`, with client methods such as `thread.add_messages(return_context=True)`, `thread.get_user_context()` and `client.graph.edge.delete()` used across its quick start and guides. It also offers framework integrations (LangGraph, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK and others) and the open-source Graphiti library. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs in other languages (e.g. TypeScript/Go), dedicated SDK reference docs or versioning, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.
